cards.evidence_note: 8 distinct tasks; 2 repetitions per task and harness version. Pass differences and cost means use equal task weights; pass counts include every selected attempt. Recorded verifier image/environment identities match within each task. Recorded configuration details are unavailable. Observed differences are not causal and do not establish future superiority. Exploratory 95% task-cluster intervals use 10,000 deterministic resamples; repetitions are not independent tasks or paired random seeds. No correction for multiple comparisons or winner selection. Secondary cost/token intervals describe means, not headline token medians. Original grades remain unchanged; corrected verification is a separate audit with limited replay coverage.
